{07 04 00}Ow! {01 00 00 14 00}{07 15 00}What do you think
you're doing, {04 1f 00}!
You're lucky I'm a pacifist!
{07 05 00}Watch where you swing that
thing, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 04 00}Ai! {01 00 00 14 00}{07 15 00}Mida sa arvad,

Sul veab, et olen patsifist!
{07 05 00}Vaata, kuhu sa selle
asjaga vehid, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}That is, like, {01 00 00 05 00}so not cool!
{07 05 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}If you're just dying to hit
someone, hit yourself!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}See on, nagu, {01 00 00 05 00}NII mitte
lahe! {07 05 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Kui sa tahad kedagi
lüüa, löö iseennast!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Just keep it up!{01 00 00 0a 00} 'Cause you
know, {04 1f 00}, what
goes around comes around!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Jätka aga!{01 00 00 0a 00} Sest sa
tead, {04 1f 00}, et
kõik tuleb tagasi!
